title: Kissed Nutty Korean Raspberry Anju
description: A nutty and fluffy Korean dish featuring raspberries and pickle, perfect for a crowd, this satvik-friendly anju is served on a wooden board.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, and salt.
In a separate bowl, mix together rice vinegar, maple syrup, and coconut oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Fold in the chopped nuts and toasted sesame seeds.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Cut into desired shapes using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place the shapes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Allow to cool completely on a wire rack.
To serve, place the anju on a wooden board and top with raspberries and pickle.
